site.title: WORLDSMITH
site.tagline: Explorable Halloween worlds — rendered as light, walked as splats

worlds.title: Graveyard in the Fog
worlds.description: A fog-drowned churchyard at midnight. Tilted stones, a lone candle on a stone plinth, mist swallowing everything past ten feet.

worlds.title: The Stone Angel
worlds.description: A Victorian cemetery under a towering eroded angel. Dozens of votive candles flicker at its base while fog walls close in.
